niceToHave: practice-check (pq1 a, en): 'keep adding items as a Must' can be read as 'keep adding more items'; quote the feature name instead — 'Move only the sorting to Should; keep adding items as a Must'→'Move only the sorting to Should; keep "add items" as a Must'

practice-check (pq1 explanation, en): 'so that moves to Should' has a vague referent — 'The goal can be met without sorting, so that moves to Should.'→'The goal can be met without sorting, so sorting moves to Should.'
practice-prompt-plan: 「知れる」 is colloquial; a neutral form suits a var hint better — 「例：幹事が参加人数を早く知れる出欠確認アプリ」→「例：参加人数がすぐわかる出欠確認アプリ」
practice-steps-plan (p-plan hint): 「勝手に」 sounds like blame — 「AIが勝手に埋めた項目があれば」→「自分が決めていない項目をAIが埋めていたら」
glossary: the definition endings are inconsistent — 「…自分の考えを言葉にしていくこと。」→「…自分の考えを言葉にしていくことです。」, 「…を1枚に並べた文書。」→「…を1枚に並べた文書です。」
check-quiz (pq3, en): the same JP label 「レシピの表示」 is rendered two ways in one prompt — 'The Musts are "recipe list" and "show a recipe"'→'The Musts are "recipe list" and "recipe view"'
summary-ask (en): 'with … with me' repeats — 'Go through my one-page plan with the checklist with me'→'Go through my one-page plan against the checklist with me'
check-quiz (pq2 explanation): the subject and the predicate are far apart — 「ただ、つけ忘れると次に見る前回の記録が残らないので、重要なShouldです。」→「ただ、つけ忘れると、次に見る前回の記録が残りません。だから重要なShouldです。」
